description.value:
Requirements Continuation; you just hit an enemy with Savage Claw, and that enemy is still within your melee reach. Use this immediately after that Strike resolves: any other action in between closes the opening (reactions do not). Frequency once per round, shared by all Continuation follow-ups.

Deal 1d6 fire damage, increasing to 2d6 at 14th level and 3d6 at 20th. No attack or save; no MAP; no critical doubling. This is a separate damage effect for immunity, weakness, and resistance. No Mercy and property-rune damage do not apply. Aetheric Calibration may change its fire damage. Consume the opening.
